title: Australian Chickpea Flatbread
description: A delicious and easy-to-make flatbread recipe from Australia, topped with chickpeas.

ingredients.name: optional: herbs and spices
ingredients.notes: such as garlic powder or oregano

instructions: In a large bowl, combine naturally flaky flour and salt.
Gradually add in Australian olive oil and water, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 2-3 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Transfer the dough to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
While the flatbread is baking, heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add chickpeas to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes or until lightly browned.
To assemble the dish, place a piece of flatbread on a plate, top with chickpeas, and add any desired herbs and spices.
